data.title: 雪之下阳乃 · 海滨停车点的短暂停留
data.description: 海边观景停车点，阳乃穿扣好的象牙色亚麻衬衫与驼色阔腿裤，侧坐在停稳的敞篷车驾驶座。她把墨镜推到发顶，单手拢住被风吹乱的黑发，望向海面的神情比宴会时放松得多。
data.action: 在停稳的敞篷车里推起墨镜，拢好被海风吹乱的发丝。
data.promptProse: Haruno rests sideways in the driver's seat of the parked convertible, pushing sunglasses onto her head and gathering a windblown black strand with quiet ease. Buttoned ivory linen shirt and camel wide-leg trousers retain the coastal outfit. The horizontal medium view includes dashboard, open door and shoreline beyond. Reflected late-afternoon light reveals her eyes and relaxed hand, with dashboard shade beneath the door's sunlit edge and softer fabric folds.
